observations: Photo 0: Front view of a black Nikon DSLR camera with a lens attached. The lens has 'DX' and 'Nikon' visible. The camera body has 'Nikon' branding. The lens appears used, with visible dust and wear. The camera is placed on a patterned fabric surface.

Photo 1: Side view of the same camera, showing the mode dial, shutter button, and lens. The lens barrel has 'DX' and 'Nikon' visible. The camera body has 'Nikon' branding. The lens has '24-120mm' visible on the front ring.

Photo 2: Front view of the camera with lens, lens cap placed beside it. The camera body has 'Nikon' branding. The lens has '24-120mm' visible on the front ring. The camera is on a patterned fabric surface. The lens cap has '24-120mm' visible on the front ring.
All photos show the same camera with the same lens, no visible damage to the body or lens. The lens cap is separate in photo 2.

claims.claim: The D3200 is a pro-level camera, it's certainly more than accessible by those who are not...
claims.evidence: The seller's text is subjective and does not provide verifiable evidence. The camera appears to be a Nikon DSLR, but the model is not clearly visible in any photo.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The camera may not be functional (e.g., shutter failure, sensor damage, or software issues).
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, and displaying the image on a screen.

risks.risk: The lens may have internal damage or fungus not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens glass, especially the front and rear elements, under bright light.

risks.risk: The camera may have a high shutter count (beyond 5000) or be near end-of-life.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the camera's shutter count from a recent photo taken with the camera.

risks.risk: The camera may have missing or damaged accessories (e.g., battery, charger, strap).
risks.proof: Photos of the battery, charger, and any included accessories.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Close-up photo of the lens glass under bright light.
Screenshot of the camera's shutter count.
Photos of the battery, charger, and any included accessories.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
